gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold CC includes diarrhea and central abdominal pain for 3 days. Generated CC mentions 3-day diarrhea and cramps and one vomiting episode; it omits that abdominal pain has been present for 3 days.

Gold specifies watery diarrhea 5–6/day, no blood, and incomplete evacuation. Generated facts include no blood (hpi-003) and incomplete evacuation (hpi-002) but do not state 5–6/day watery stools; they instead describe toilet use every 10 minutes, which is different and not equivalent.

Gold: central abdominal pain since onset, no radiation, mild-to-moderate tenderness and cramping. Generated hpi-004 describes periumbilical/sub-umbilical crampy pain and mild pain with self-pressure, but does not state duration since onset or non-radiation or tenderness; therefore the gold fact is only partially reflected and not fully covered.

Gold: eating and drinking provoke nausea and gas. Generated facts mention nausea (hpi-006) and pain relieved by BM/gas (hpi-005) but do not state that eating/drinking trigger nausea or gas sensation; thus the causal relationship is missing.

Gold: some vomiting and now unable to tolerate fluids and solids (ongoing, more than one episode implied). Generated facts (cc-001, hpi-007) state a single vomiting episode this morning and do not state inability to tolerate fluids/solids; instead they note only decreased intake (hpi-009). This directly conflicts with the gold description of current intolerance.
Gold: ate this morning and vomited immediately. Generated hpi-007 says 1x emesis this AM after eating fruit, but omits the immediacy component; therefore the temporal detail is not fully captured.

Gold: patient feels and looks dehydrated. Generated hpi-009 states decreased PO intake and “likely under-hydrated,” which is an inference rather than the patient feeling/appearing dehydrated. The specific subjective and objective descriptors from gold are not explicitly present.
Gold: unable to go to work due to frequency of bowel movements. Generated hpi-014 and sh-001: staying home/unable to work due to stool frequency. This is effectively the same fact.
Gold: history of childhood asthma. Generated pmh-001: history of asthma (no age qualifier). Core diagnosis is captured, though childhood onset detail is omitted; still reasonably covered.
Gold: NKDA. Generated allergy-001: no known drug allergies. Direct match.

Gold: father has history of stomach cancer. Generated fh-001: father died of cancer ~10 years ago with no specification of stomach. These are different cancers; one specifies site, the other omits site and adds death and timing. Because site is clinically important and unspecified in generated, it conflicts with the more precise gold history of stomach cancer.
Gold: denies fever. Generated hpi-010: denies fever. Same core fact, though generated adds night sweats/uncertainty about low-grade fever as additional context.

Gold: no breathing problems. Generated notes (hpi-011, hpi-012) address asthma history, inhaler use, and no change in baseline SOB; they do not clearly state absence of breathing problems overall. Baseline SOB may exist, so the gold “no problems with breathing” is not fully captured.
Gold: patient denies chest pain. Generated hpi-013: no chest pain. Directly covered.
Gold: denies headache. No generated fact mentions headache; thus omitted.
Gold: DDx gastroenteritis. Generated asm-001: acute gastroenteritis/foodborne illness diagnosed, which encompasses gastroenteritis; the condition is included, though framed more definitively.
Gold: advised fluids for rehydration. Generated plan-001: increase oral fluids for presumed gastroenteritis. Same action; indication is specified but consistent.
Gold: advised to stay at home for the time being. Generated plan-003: stay home until symptoms improving. This conveys the same instruction with a slightly more specific condition.
Gold: monitor for fever. Generated plan-002: monitor for fevers. Directly covered.

Gold: if symptoms do not improve, visit GP surgery. Generated plan-005: if worsening or not improving over next 1–2 days, arrange in-person GP review for abdominal exam. Same essential follow-up instruction with added time frame and purpose.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold CC: diarrhea and central abdominal pain for 3 days; vomiting is not part of the chief complaint. Generated CC adds one episode of vomiting this morning to the chief complaint and specifies midline lower abdominal cramps (vs. central abdominal pain). Both adding vomiting into CC and altering pain location contradict the simpler gold CC.

Frequent urges and toilet use every 10 minutes are not described in any gold fact. This adds detail about urgency/frequency beyond the gold 5–6/day description; not directly supported nor contradicted.
Gold hpi-001: patient feels incomplete evacuation. Generated hpi-002 repeats this. Direct support.
Gold hpi-001: diarrhea has no blood. Generated hpi-003: no blood in diarrhea. Directly matches.

Gold hpi-002: central abdominal pain, mild-to-moderate tenderness, cramping. Generated hpi-004: periumbilical/sub-umbilical, crampy, mild pain with self-pressure. Overlaps in cramping and central area but adds specific regions and the self-pressure detail, which is not in gold.
Pain relieved by BM/passing gas is not documented in the gold facts. This is new information without support or conflict.
Gold hpi-003: eating/drinking cause nausea. This implies the presence of nausea. Generated hpi-006 states nausea, consistent with gold, though the specific trigger is omitted.

Gold hpi-004 and hpi-005 describe some vomiting and immediate vomiting after eating this morning, plus current inability to tolerate fluids/solids. Generated hpi-007 constrains it to a single episode after fruit this morning, underrepresenting the extent and timing of vomiting and current intolerance.
Gold does not mention hematemesis or strawberries. The clarification that red color was from strawberries and no hematemesis is new information.

Gold hpi-004: now unable to tolerate fluids and solids. Generated hpi-009: decreased oral intake and likely under-hydrated. This implies some ongoing intake, contradicting the gold statement of current inability to tolerate fluids and solids.

Gold ros-001 only states no fever. Generated hpi-010 repeats denial of fever (supported) but adds night sweats and uncertainty about low-grade fever, which are not mentioned in gold; these extra elements are additions.
Gold pmh-001: history of childhood asthma. Generated hpi-011: history of asthma and using an inhaler. The asthma history is supported; inhaler use is an additional detail.
Gold notes no breathing problems (ROS) but does not specify baseline SOB or changes. Generated hpi-012 adds the concept of baseline SOB with no change, which is not in the gold record.
Gold ros-003: no chest pain. Generated hpi-013: no CP. Directly supported.
Gold hpi-007: unable to go to work due to frequency of bowel movements. Generated hpi-014 matches this fact. Direct support.
Gold: asthma (childhood). Generated: history of asthma. Supported; age of onset detail is omitted but not contradicted.
Gold contains no medication list. The use of an inhaler is new information.
Brand change and prior inhaler running out are not present in gold; purely additional detail.
Gold: NKDA. Generated: no known drug allergies. Directly supported.

Gold: father has history of stomach cancer (site specified, living status not stated). Generated: father died of cancer ~10 years ago (site unspecified). Because gold specifies stomach cancer and generated omits the site and introduces death and timing, it conflicts with the more specific gold FHx.
Same as hpi-014: unable to work due to stool frequency and staying home. Supported by gold hpi-007.

Gold assessment lists DDx gastroenteritis. Generated asm-001: acute gastroenteritis/foodborne illness diagnosed. Includes gastroenteritis with additional specification and similar clinical description; supported.

Gold mentions feeling/looking dehydrated but does not explicitly state a separate assessment of dehydration risk. Generated asm-002 formalizes this as a risk diagnosis tied to decreased PO and stool frequency; this framing is additional.
Gold only notes childhood asthma in PMH, without current assessment. Generated asm-003 provides a stability assessment and links it to inhaler brand change. This is additional.
Gold does not mention health anxiety or concerns about malignancy or reassurance. This is new assessment information.
Gold: plan for fluids. Generated: increase oral fluids for presumed gastroenteritis. The core intervention aligns; indication is added but consistent.
Gold: monitor for fever. Generated: monitor for fevers. Directly supported.
Gold: stay at home for the time being. Generated: stay home until improving. Same action with slightly refined condition; supported.
Avoidance of antibiotics is not mentioned in any gold plan item; this is new plan content.

Gold: if symptoms do not improve, visit GP surgery. Generated: if worsening or not improving over 1–2 days, arrange in-person GP review for abdominal exam. Same follow-up destination and trigger, with added time frame and purpose; supported.
Gold has no plan elements related to asthma or attributing GI symptoms to inhaler. This asthma management note is additional.
